deviations_from_proposed_mission: The proposed legacy-vs-redesigned contrast at the NEAR halo would have been near-null: the mechanical audit shows the legacy filter already delivers 82.4% of want at gd==2. The filter contrast is therefore placed at gd==1, where legacy delivers 0.5% and the redesign delivers 100%. This is the sharpest available and the only non-null placement.

A DOSE LADDER replaces the pulse/burst schedule arms. The audit proves delivery, not schedule, is the binding mechanism, and a schedule cannot move a delivery ceiling. PULSE_DEPENDENT_CAPTURE_DEV is therefore UNAVAILABLE as a disposition in this mission and is declared so.

PER_EVENT_PROVENANCE fields are AGGREGATED into a single FRESH_SOURCE field. No endpoint resolves individual events; 80 advected fields per trajectory is not affordable. Exact conservation m = INCUMBENT + AMBIENT + FRESH is still enforced after every mutation and step.

DYNAMICS_MEDIATED_CAPTURE is split into capture_transport / capture_engulfment / capture_by_merger. Only capture_transport (fresh mass appearing in a cell that was ALREADY in the track) feeds the primary endpoint. Boundary expansion over standing matter is NOT transport and is reported separately. The proposed mission did not distinguish these.
INCORPORATION_16 / DURABLE_INCORPORATION_128 use a rolling-window MINIMUM of fresh mass inside the track. This lower-bounds continuously-resident mass and can only UNDERSTATE.
